featured_reviews.name: Rhea Gursahani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Both my kids, Krrish and Koel have been with Da Vinci Montessori since Dec 2021 and we intend on continuing with the school as long as we are in the city and respective grades are supported by DVM.

Having experienced both the international and Montessori curriculums, I have seen my kids blossom into independent and opinionated individuals who also empathize and understand the situation around them, with the Montessori curriculum.

Koel was 14 months when she joined Da Vinci in the Toddler Class. 3 months ago, some of the students in Koel's class moved onto the Primary section. This also meant that several young kids now came to her class, and my little girl who once was a baby of the class transformed into the big sister. One day, as I was waiting to receive her, I was narrated a very sweet story by her teacher which touched my heart to the deepest levels.

As was informed, when the younger kids wanted something in class, Koel was the first one to notice, and she would stop whatever activity she was doing, to help the young child. One day, a young toddler was thirsty and made a gesture for the same. Koel noticed this from the other end of the class and ran to pour a glass of water for him. After sometime the young tod was thirsty again but instead of figuring what to do, he immediately went to look for Koel and asked her to pour him another glass of water.

Why I chose to share this story is because it very  beautifully depicts the empathy of the elder child and the independence of the younger one which all blossomed with their simple interaction in class. While the curriculum covers the knowledge aspect, it is these interactions of a mixed age classroom that really transform these young children into independent and caring humans.

Being the 2nd child and a COVID era baby, Koel did not enjoy as much Mama playtime and attention that her elder brother did, but, whatever she has learnt be it life skills, motor skills, empathy, language, knowledge has all been from DVM.

When Krrish joined DVM, he was 4.5 years old and we were returning from a post COVID era. If COVID was tough on us, it was worse with the kids who lost their sense of social being. Krrish was always pro learning but online schooling really got him disinterested in the concept of school. However, with the independence of choice given in the Montessori classroom, Krrish's love for school and learning was back. He was able to pick up the concepts quickly and now is a part of the Elementary class.

So while DVM is a beautiful option for Montessori what sets them apart are the people behind it and the genuine care and affection for the children and their well being. While the ideology is traditional the outlook is modern, to enable children to be successful in the fact paced, tech controlled life today!

Even while being a Montessori curriculum, the children are exposed to a variety of activities on par with international schools, such as Art, Speech and Drama, Physical Fitness, Capoeira, Spanish Music, in the Elementary classroom, and Music, Art, Fitness and Yoga in the Primary and Toddler classrooms.

The head of the school, Ms. Ashani, is deeply invested in ensuring that while the kids continue to learn from the Montessori classroom their future is safeguarded too, hence working on several tie ups with prominent big schools and introducing kids to a variety of inter school activities. The sincerity runs top down and the love, concern and nurturing can be seen in all members of the school from the administrator to each of the teachers in the Toddler, Primary and Elemnentary classroom, as well as the Didis!

I couldn't have asked for a better school for my kids! Thank you for making us a part of the DVM family!

The play-based learning, caring teachers, and safe, creative environment made every day exciting and full of growth. I witnessed great progress in social skills, curiosity, and happiness. It is truly one of the best preschools and daycare centers!

featured_reviews.name: Lovinaa Coelho
featured_reviews.review_text: Here's to all the wonderful teachers for their tireless efforts and dedication. Every choreography, every performance, and every moment—right from the pre-practice planning to the post-event execution—was handled with such grace. The energy, enthusiasm, and passion you bring truly shine through the children. Hats off to your incredible spirit, commitment, and teamwork. 🥳😍🤗

featured_reviews.name: AAH Kids
featured_reviews.review_text: It was the first year of Hasnain being in this school unaware we had skipped nursery for him started of with junior kg yet undeniable efforts of teachers explaining concepts patiently calmly while handling these chaotic children commendable!! A good academic year spent grateful!!!❤️❤️🫂

featured_reviews.name: Maitri Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
The teachers and staff are really good....they put their heart and soul in each event even if its the smallest celebration....our wards have actually learnt a lot at school and we highly appreciate what the teachers are doing for it....they also send videos of what our kids are doing in class, daily, which is a bigggg plus!!!
However what i strongly condemn is their faith biasness....they gave a holiday on Eid but not on Ram Navami....majority <minority....absolutely unfair....
Also my ward used to come uncleaned potty many days which I had reminded the teacher repeatedly....

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Mashru
featured_reviews.review_text:
Munchkins is a wonderful pre-school for our Lil one which have excellent activities for nurturing and developing them and teachers are amazing ,loving and caring.It has a safe and secured environment for children.
My child vihaan Gosalia was there for 2 years and we had a amazing experience.Thank you to all the teachers staff and everyone connected to munchkins.

featured_reviews.name: Sai Chitale
featured_reviews.review_text: I am sending my son to Kiddie Kingdom since more than a year. Deepti is wonderful, approachable & super understanding. Children love this place. I would recommend it to anyone & everything. The best feeling is my son is happy to go there & looks forward to meeting everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Shalaka Vaidya
featured_reviews.review_text: My daughter loved Kiddie Kingdom. She used to enjoy a lot with other kids and of course, the lovely, Deepti teacher. The place was very clean, food was good and the staff took good care of the kids. Overall, it was a safe and healthy environment for the kids. I wish a great success to Kiddie Kingdom on re-opening.

featured_reviews.name: Deepa Koppikar
featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommended day care centre. My twin boys loved being in Kiddie Kingdom. They have good trained staff , they serve excellent home cooked healthy food and lots of fun activities and toys to keep kids occupied. My kids made lot of friends.

featured_reviews.name: Gauravi Naik
featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommend Kiddie Kingdom. The teachers and assistants are amazing.  The teachers excel at building child’s skills in a very fun and interactive way. Everything here, from the books, toys and decor is curated to create a warm, nurturing and a loving environment. The facilities are clean and bright, and they offer healthy meals.

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Gupte
featured_reviews.review_text: My kid is very comfortable in Kiddie Kingdom. He loves playing with other kids and is also taken care off well by Deepti and other maushis.

featured_reviews.name: prachi vadhavkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent service and trustworthy, loving and smart teacher. My son loves going to kiddie Kingdom. It's been over 1 1/2 years my son goes here. Highly recommended!!!

featured_reviews.name: P V
featured_reviews.review_text: Great place, my son loved it here!! its like a home away from home for the kids. Very well managed. Kids enjoy a lot - bday parties, festival celebrations and summer/ diwali camps. Very loving, dedicated and creative teacher! Lunch and snacks are also well done, my son still talks about the food😊 highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Sali
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent place for kids. They maintain a very good hygiene and provide very healthy food..My daughter enjoyed playing and learning in kiddie kingdom..Kids are engaged in various activities and they don't feel away from home...The teacher and other staff is very experienced and helpful...Highly recommended and safe place for kids
